title: POST /v1/commerce/acme/lift, the commerce key (a write): the CT reconciliation found no certificate for these keys in the logs, so the slot their lapsed reservation keeps is released. The broker lifts only a key that is a lapsed first reservation at least policy.budget.lapsed_lift_after_s past its end; any other key in the list is left as it is. The key stays recorded and expected for ever, so a certificate that turns up later is still not foreign.
